title: Shared bounded decoding and public event aggregation pump
api_or_output: Internal shared sync/async streaming pump and sixteen-event sink

acceptance.description: Implement approved internal supply/advance/resource-service pump over integrated decoder/core and callbacks, with bounded one-tag/effective-DTD cursors, exact byte/character source offsets and aggregate event projection.

Test every notification pause without replay, all input chunk splits, declaration/encoding framing, CDATA/comment/PI boundaries, defaults/unresolved values/DTD projections, fatal and callback exception/cancellation lifetime behavior, async resource suspension; no unbounded event queue or hidden DOM.
Record real zero-allocation borrowed event and bounded scratch evidence, compile without later public adapters, preserve integrated M2 semantics and validate at a known tested revision.

handoff.summary: Single runtime owner for frozen pump; SAX/push/reader consume this integrated prerequisite independently.
